voci.proprieta: conformational distribution in solution (RDF) in isopropanol and isopropanol/n-hexane
voci.qualitativo: similar conformational distribution in the two solvent systems; N1-C22, H2-H3, C22-C20, O2-C19 distances
voci.citazione: The RDF results at the four characteristic distances suggest that the conformational distribution of the ﬂuralaner molecule is similar in isopropanol and isopropanol/n-hexane, which may be related to the fact that both forms crystallize by the same conformation.

voci.proprieta: selective nucleation mechanism proposed from the MD results
voci.qualitativo: n-hexane reduces the proximity of Cl2 of the R molecule and F2 of the S molecule; Form I (with Cl2-F2 interaction) in isopropanol, Form III in isopropanol/n-hexane
voci.citazione: As a result, Form I with Cl2-F2 interactions in the structure is generated in isopropanol, while Form III is generated in isopropanol/n-hexane.
